items.title: Etale pullback computes the conormal sheaf of an immersion of algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces and an etale morphism U -> X with U a scheme, the lemma identifies the conormal sheaf C_{Z/X} restricted to Z_U with the conormal sheaf C_{Z_U/U}, canonically and functorially in U. The proof chooses a closed subspace T whose complement carries the immersion, takes the defining ideal sheaf I, and verifies that the restriction of I computes the induced immersion, clear from the construction of the ideal in the closed-immersion lemma. Retained author proof at lines 443-452.
